description: The chart represents the distribution of four categories (N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-) across three difficulty levels (easy, medium, and hard) in a zero-shot context. Each pie chart has four slices, corresponding to the four categories, and is labeled with the respective difficulty level. The easy chart has slices labeled N+K+ (green, 55.4%), N-K+ (yellow, 38.3%), N+K- (red, 1.7%), and N-K- (orange, 4.6%). The medium chart has slices labeled N+K+ (green, 58.8%), N-K+ (yellow, 35.4%), N-K- (orange, 4.0%), and N+K- (red, 1.8%). The hard chart has slices labeled N-K- (orange, 37.9%), N+K+ (green, 37.3%), N-K+ (yellow, 18.1%), and N+K- (red, 6.7%). The chart includes a legend on the right side, indicating the color corresponding to each category, and percentage labels are shown inside each slice. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded. The proportions of the slices vary across the three charts, with the hard chart showing a more even distribution among the categories compared to the easy and medium charts.
